name: mapping
description: Compliance-mapping extraction and crosswalk tooling. Turns mapping-source documents into structured, verifiable artifacts: /mapping-ucmapper extracts a Unified Compliance Framework Authority Document from the public UCF mapper API into a citations JSON (full parent/child hierarchy, recomputed genealogy, cki-conformant BibTexCitation with a deliberated LicenseStamp) plus a self-contained collapsible HTML tree viewer. Deterministic transform in Python, mandatory schema reconnaissance before any transform, honest warnings[] instead of forced merges, and an independent second-fetch FNV-1a parity check before the run is allowed to declare done.
